conclusion: Three of 600 UDP echoes were missing after the drain, and the server counted 597 received/echoed datagrams. Returned echoes had no TCP-like 200–400ms tail: maximum 66.8ms. Supports delivery loss as a contributor to the earlier TCP recovery stalls; does not establish their individual cause.
limits: One 60-second run, not a simultaneous TCP control. Aggregate server counts do not establish where packets were dropped; host queues and the network remain possible. Direct endpoint snapshots do not prove the path stayed unchanged throughout. No inference-transport replacement or acceptance claim.
next: Inspect whether Tailscale diagnostic capture can safely provide filtered endpoint packet evidence without Mac sudo, and compare scoped drop/error counter deltas during a bounded follow-up. Preserve failed probes; do not change network settings blindly.
